notes.title: Reapply corrected Patch 6.32
notes.notes:
1. Reverse to 6.1 because of overwrite of setting.dat file, result in global save corruption
2. Re-uploaded corrected Patch 6.32

Sorry! The global save data was accidentally overwritten. We recommend backing up the save/setting.dat file in the root directory. If you need to recover it, it must be rewritten manually for each person. Affected players can send the setting.dat file along with the CGs, endings, and other items to be unlocked to cs@firedogstudio.com. Please understand that recovery will take some time.
